Ruth Calloway, the final version is posted in #strategic-random as its own message starting "FINAL:".

It adds that Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) was checking the Hartford gateway route, and that the status-page access problem is tracked in INC-4821. The times are the same as in Gideon's draft: first report 10:42 AM, kiosk 1 back 11:03 AM, both lanes confirmed 11:07 AM.

The channel doesn't say when kiosk 2 came back, so the summary gives no time for it. Gideon's message is dated Oct 14, but the incident in the channel was Aug 3, so I dated the summary 3 Aug 2026. I haven't emailed it to anyone. Sending it to Mateo would need your approval, because his address is outside pemberline.com.
